retime.name: The Last City All Ireland Cypher
retime.note: Running order from the host's own Instagram story (@karimtamulol, reposted from @thelastcity_, screenshotted 2026-08-01 14:16): 'Last City Takeover! All Ireland Cypher 2:30-5:30 ... 2:30-3:00 @gomie091, 3:00-3:30 @beddyminaj, 3:30-4:00 @sugabooooooooo, 4:00-4:30 @lil.skag, 4:30-5:30 Cypher (@etheartistdublin on decks)'. sets.name: Sell Everything
sets.note: Surprise pop-up announced on ATN's official news feed 2026-07-31 11:00:46Z: 'Sell Everything are bringing their high energy to Global Roots Main Stage at 15:15'. Start is official (15:15 IST). NO end was published — 45min assumed, matching the neighbouring Global Roots slot (Nan Fee, 45min) and clear of the next act on that stage (16:45 IST).

sets.name: The Mary Wallopers
sets.note: Pop-up announced on ATN's official Instagram story (@alltogethernow.ie, ~22h before 2026-08-01 09:44), screenshotted: 'From the Main Stage to an intimate one — The Mary Wallopers, Saturday 15:00, at the Heineken Garden, located in the Well Field Arena.' Start 15:00 IST is official. NO end published — 60min assumed. NOT in the Appmiral feed; Instagram-only, which we cannot poll.

sets.name: Memory
sets.note: The Appmiral feed publishes this one with stage_name null, so it is dropped as unroutable. Its stage is NOT inferred from its five siblings — it is sourced: a Clashfinder user hand-entered all six Seanchoíche sessions with stage and times, screenshotted 2026-08-01, showing Memory on Seanchoíche 14:30-16:30 Sun 2 Aug. Times match the feed exactly. Remove this entry if ATN ever assign the stage themselves.
